mainEntity.name: How quickly can you install in King City?

acceptedAnswer.text: We're local, so site visits are easy to book. Delivery timing depends on the model; we'll give you a firm schedule when you order.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a backyard sauna in King City?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accessory building over 10 m² typically needs a building permit, zoning setbacks apply, and the electrical connection needs an ESA permit. We check your model and lot before you order.

mainEntity.name: Can I see the saunas before buying?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Book a visit to our showroom at 17380 Highway 27, Schomberg.

mainEntity.name: How much does delivery and installation cost in King City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario, including King City. Delivery only is $450. HST is shown separately on every quote.

mainEntity.name: What heater size does my sauna need?

acceptedAnswer.text: We size every heater to the sauna's interior volume plus extra for glass. None of our saunas take less than a 6 kW heater; larger models use 9 to 10.5 kW electric or a wood stove where there's room for its clearances.
